title: Man found dead between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo; sheriff's office investigating
excerpt: A man was found dead Friday evening in the area between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo, and the Webb County Sheriff's Office says the death is under investigation.
content:
A man was found dead Friday evening in the area between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo, and the Webb County Sheriff's Office says the death is under investigation.

Deputies responded around 5:56 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20, to a call about a deceased male in that area, the Sheriff's Office said in a statement shared by Webb County.

Preliminary information indicates the man was a third-party contractor performing work for Webb County in the area. His name had not been released.

The Fire Department was also notified because of a possible hazardous materials concern, according to the statement.

The investigation remains active and in its very preliminary stages, the Sheriff's Office said. Authorities confirmed one deceased male.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar extended his deepest condolences to the man's family and loved ones. The Sheriff's Office said it will provide additional information as it becomes available.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, Nov. 20, 2026; shared by Webb County, Texas.
